title: fix(ci): repair beta qualification boundaries
body:
## Summary
Repair required release-qualification failures without adding release features.

- Remove unused private helpers and stale re-exports; retain test-consumed boundaries explicitly in the existing deadcode configuration.
- Repair check-limits advisory logging, inherited release-context isolation, and the checklist fixture's canonical TypeScript loader.
- Reconcile the SDK surface budget with individually attributed existing exports; replace the wildcard service export with explicit names and move unchanged outbound routing into its owning module to preserve the line limit and public surface.
- Correct beta-sensitive update fixture channel selection and await asynchronous raw-stream diagnostic writes in the Incognito fixture.
- Keep read-only transcript preparation on shared navigation without pulling host logging/Gateway lifecycle into its graph. Preserve the public JSONL parser export.
- Shorten the remote-ingress fixture root without changing its request or authorization assertions.

## Evidence
- Unmodified main SDK surface gate reproduced four budget/wildcard failures; repaired gate passes. Public export names preserved; wildcard count zero.
- Targeted main tests: three shards passed (20 + 388 + 12 tests). Required main build passed.
- Selected release-cut deadcode checks passed all three scopes. Newer main has two unrelated unused exports (parseRfbVersionBanner and openBrowserRequestApproval), intentionally untouched; they are not caused by this change.
- Beta config convergence: baseline reproduced failure, fixed 14/14.
- Incognito diagnostic fixture: baseline regular-mode failure reproduced; corrected fixture plus real raw-stream sibling 6/6.
- Targeted type-aware lint clean, including the two fixture changes; diff check clean.
- Main advanced across disjoint template/state/locale changes during preparation; only this repair branch was rebased. The release's selected product baseline was not changed.

- Shorten the history membership fixture root via its existing prefix option; CI job 133683538969 reported an overlong nested Unix socket path (EINVAL). Unchanged local fixture also passes, so this is a CI-path correction, not a claimed local red/green reproduction. Corrected fixture passes 2/2, targeted format and type-aware lint clean.

## Follow-up repair evidence
- On the pinned release candidate, the transcript graph regression failed before the navigation repair; graph/navigation/replay suites passed 48 tests afterward, and the full build passed.
- Canonical local package integrity, isolated installation/lifecycle scripts, installed-tree inventory and CLI startup passed after the graph repair: 46,827 entries versus the unchanged 47,500 limit (5,401 fewer). This is local repaired-tree evidence, not new exact-SHA remote release qualification.
- Remote-ingress fixture passed 12 tests with the shortened path; targeted lint passed.
- Main advanced and produced an equivalent Knip callback conflict. The prior auto-merge request was explicitly retired before repair; the resolution preserves both the reviewed callback and the upstream batch entry. Only the main repair branch was integrated; the release baseline remains pinned. New-head focused proof passed 60 distinct tests across graph, bounded navigation, replay storage, and remote ingress. This is tracked separately from the earlier head’s evidence.
- Simplification pass: one shared navigation owner replaces the preparation worker’s dependency on the writable host manager; JSONL warning emission stays host-owned with its existing public export. No new runtime policy, state store, compatibility branch, or retry was introduced. The added tests cover bounded/opaque ancestry and the static host-logging boundary, not a file-count quota.

- Corrected the bounded-navigation regression fixture to use the contract’s Map fields (not iterable arrays), resolving CI job 133724905350’s three TS2740 errors. The exact core test typecheck leaf, both navigation tests, formatting, and type-aware lint pass.

- Removed the redundant JSONL type assertion exposed by CI job 133728740785 and reduced the former codec allowance from 5 to 4; no baseline allowance was increased. Exact assertion-safety ratchet passes (2,364 files), JSONL replay passes 3/3, and targeted type-aware lint is clean at commit 56829b6c0e2b.

- Resolved overlap with current main at 687dc6c99a32, including #200321: retained its host-only hydration layer and this PR’s shared navigation/host-only JSONL boundary. Conflict resolution passes the complete graph/navigation/replay selection, 40 hydration/ownership tests, and four-file type-aware lint. The release branch and selected beta baseline were not changed. Merge commit: 49bd7a564592.

## Scope and review
Independent review was explicitly waived by the requesting maintainer for this session; all qualification gates remain required. Direct main publication was attempted under the red-main repair workflow and rejected by the repository's PR requirement; this is the prescribed PR fallback. No beta has been published by this change. A release-only capacity fixture correction remains on the release branch and is not included here.
